articles.title: How to bet on 2026 PGA Championship: Betting guide, odds, picks, field, tips, promos, offers at Aronimink
articles.summary: Aronimink Golf Club in Pennsylvania, USA, has been selected to host its second major golf tournament, the 2026 PGA Championship. This prestigious event signifies a significant moment for the club, which previously hosted the 1962 PGA Championship, won by golf legend Gary Player. The championship is a globally recognized sporting event, attracting top international golfers and widespread media attention.

articles.title: A username could one day suffice as your address
articles.summary: The Indian government is developing a UPI-style unique username-based digital addressing system. This innovative platform will enable citizens to send and receive parcels, letters, and food deliveries using a digital identifier, eliminating the need to share full physical addresses. This initiative aims to streamline logistics and enhance privacy for various services, significantly modernizing India's digital infrastructure.

articles.title: Sunk Russian ship held nuclear reactor components: Spanish govt
articles.summary: A US-sanctioned Russian cargo ship that sank in the Mediterranean Sea in 2024 was reportedly carrying "nuclear reactor components." The Spanish government disclosed this cargo was similar to those found in nuclear submarines, indicating potential military connections. This incident raises significant international security concerns regarding illicit transport of sensitive materials by sanctioned entities and maritime safety.

articles.title: From oncology to obesity, Pfizer bets big on India for its next growth wave
articles.summary: US pharmaceutical giant Pfizer, recovering from a post-pandemic revenue decline, has identified India as a critical strategic growth engine. The company plans to focus its next wave of investments and expansion in India across key therapeutic areas such as oncology, obesity, and vaccines, leveraging India's potential for significant market growth and healthcare innovation.

articles.title: Trump's Pentagon is looking to 'disruptive' defense newcomers to build large stockpiles of cheap missiles for future wars
articles.summary: A Trident II D5 missile was test-launched from a US Navy Ohio-class ballistic missile submarine, demonstrating ongoing strategic defense capabilities. The Pentagon is also noted for "betting on relative newcomers like Anduril," indicating a broader trend towards leveraging new companies and technologies in the defense sector for future advancements.

articles.title: W Magazine Finds New Home in 12K SF at Durst’s One World Trade Center
articles.summary: W Magazine, a prominent American fashion and culture publication, has secured a long-term lease for 12,456 square feet on the 46th floor of One World Trade Center. This move highlights One WTC's continued appeal as a desirable and trendy business location, attracting significant media entities and reinforcing its status in the commercial real estate market.

articles.title: Volcano helped clean up after it erupted
articles.summary: A violent volcanic eruption in the South Pacific has unveiled a surprising natural mechanism with the potential to slow global warming. This significant discovery provides entirely new insights into atmospheric processes, highlighting how natural phenomena can influence climate regulation. Such scientific advancements are crucial for understanding and potentially addressing Earth's complex environmental challenges.

articles.title: Why the Cowboys could struggle to trade any surplus players
articles.summary: ESPN recently published an article by Aaron Schatz identifying significant roster deficiencies for all 32 NFL teams post-draft. This analysis details crucial team needs, offering insights into strategic player acquisition and team development within a premier professional sports league. Such assessments are vital for understanding the competitive landscape and potential future performance of teams.

articles.title: Rolls-Royce and HAL’s joint venture IAMPL inaugurates expanded manufacturing facility in Hosur
articles.summary: International Aerospace Manufacturing Private Limited (IAMPL), a 50:50 joint venture between Rolls-Royce and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), recently inaugurated its expanded manufacturing facility. This strategic development significantly enhances India's indigenous aerospace manufacturing capabilities, contributing to self-reliance in critical components. The collaboration between HAL and Rolls-Royce further strengthens India's defence industrial base and technological prowess, aligning with national security objectives.
